sources.label: TECHE Project Bayou Teche Paddle Trail dock locations
sources.supports: Identifies Centerville's official dock at Schwan Park, 514 Parish Road 131, at river mile 114.0.
sources.doesNotSupport: Does not publish a surveyed latitude/longitude for the dock's water-entry point.

sources.label: Google Maps aerial imagery at corrected point
sources.supports: Visible park-side landing and its relationship to the Bayou Teche shoreline.
sources.doesNotSupport: Aerial imagery does not establish access permission independently or provide survey accuracy; public identity comes from TECHE's dock listing.

sources.label: USGS National Hydrography Dataset route-coordinate audit
sources.supports: Mapped waterbody proximity and named flowline offset for the old and corrected points.
sources.doesNotSupport: Generalized/incomplete NHD centerlines are not a parcel or landing survey.

coordinateMethod: Aerial imagery estimate at the public dock landing, checked against NHD water geometry; approximately 50 ft uncertainty. Not surveyed.
